provenance.prompt: Assembled 42 distinct imagegen poses from source parts. Exact prompts, hashes, dates and crop assignments are preserved in sourceParts and generationHistory.

mirrorReview.notes: Canon review identifies Pixel by his short green hair and finds no fixed anatomical side, handed prop, eye mismatch, or directional emblem. The body art mirrors while preserving his face, curls, emerald/gold Rainbow Alley palette and separately rendered readable jersey detail.

provenance.coverage: 42 authored poses: idle6, idle-ball4, dribble10, run11 and dribble-run11.

review.source: Reviewed all42 assembled cells on light and dark backgrounds. Pixel’s short green curls, clean-shaven face, adult human anatomy and emerald/gold uniform stay consistent; empty hands leave room for the game-rendered ball. The transparent 7x6 assembly contains42 distinct complete authored poses with broad gutters and complete hair/shoes. Frame groups are idle6, idle-ball4, dribble10, run11, and dribble-run11.

assembly.operation: Isolate existing alpha bodies from each listed source part, resize each part uniformly to a shared maximum pose height of 174px, and place originals into a transparent 7x6 grid of 192x192 cells at baseline 184. No new, mirrored, held or repeated poses were created.

sourceParts.cleanup: Retained the35 complete alpha-connected athlete drawings; no additional large imagegen forms were present.
Retained the seven complete bodies above 40,000 alpha-component pixels with a two-pixel antialias fringe; removed one isolated one-pixel mark.
Retained all seven complete alpha-connected figures and their two-pixel antialias fringe. Only the last low dribble-running pose is assigned.
